title: Key Account BD Manager-New Home Division
description:
1. Identify and develop new business opportunities within the residential new construction market, including national and regional homebuilders, residential developers, EPCs, electrical contractors, and strategic channel partners.
2. Establish and maintain long-term relationships with key stakeholders in the new home construction ecosystem, including homebuilder executives, purchasing teams, construction managers, design centers, and energy solution partners.
3. Drive specification and adoption of EcoFlow residential energy storage solutions in new home communities and production homebuilding programs.
4. Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for the New Home Build channel, including builder programs, preferred vendor partnerships, and standardized ESS offerings.
5. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, engineering, operations, and service teams to support project implementation and customer success.
6. Lead contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and commercial agreements with builders, developers, and channel partners.
7. Represent EcoFlow at industry conferences, builder association events, trade shows, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand awareness and generate new business opportunities.
8. Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, incentive programs, building codes, and competitive activities within the residential construction and distributed energy industries.
9. Develop sales forecasts, manage pipeline activities, and achieve assigned revenue and market share targets for the New Home Build business.
10. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to support product roadmap development and future growth initiatives.

1. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Construction Management, Renewable Energy, or a related field. MBA preferred.
2. Minimum 7+ years of business development, sales, or account management experience within residential construction, renewable energy, energy storage, solar, electrical products, or related industries.
3. Proven track record of developing and managing strategic relationships with homebuilders, residential developers, EPCs, electrical contractors, or new construction channel partners.
4. Strong understanding of the residential new construction market, homebuilding processes, construction cycles, and builder procurement practices.
5. Experience selling energy storage, solar, smart home, electrical infrastructure, HVAC, or other residential technology solutions is highly preferred.
6. Existing network with national or regional homebuilders, residential developers, and construction industry decision-makers is strongly desired.
7. Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with strong leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
8. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence executive-level decision-makers.
9. Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global organization.
10. Preferred knowledge of residential energy storage and solar solutions, including products such as Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ Battery, FranklinWH, SolarEdge Home Battery, Sonnen, and similar residential energy management systems.

description:

title: Technical Support Engineer - T3
description:
Technical Investigation & Escalation
• Review and investigate complex technical issues escalated from Tier 2.
• Analyze system logs, commissioning data, error reports, and field findings.
• Gather and organize all technical information required for R&D; review.
• Perform root cause analysis on recurring field issues and system failures.
• Determine when issues require escalation to R&D.;
• Track escalated issues through resolution and closure.
R&D; Coordination
• Serve as the primary communication bridge between the North America Service Team and R&D.;
• Present technical cases clearly and accurately to R&D; engineers.
• Follow up on escalated issues to ensure timely responses.
• Obtain and communicate corrective actions, software fixes, engineering recommendations, and
technical guidance.
• Ensure resolutions provided by R&D; are clear, actionable, and satisfactory for field
implementation.
• Communicate technical updates, known issues, and approved solutions to the service
organization.
Process Improvement & Documentation
• Develop and maintain troubleshooting procedures and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Document root causes, corrective actions, and lessons learned from escalated cases.
• Identify recurring issues and work with R&D; to develop long-term solutions.
• Support the creation of technical bulletins and service advisories when necessary.
• Maintain accurate documentation of technical findings and resolutions.
Cross-Functional Support
• Collaborate with Product Management, Quality, and R&D; teams to investigate recurring product
issues.
• Support software and firmware validation efforts through technical review and testing.
• Provide field feedback and technical findings to support product improvements.
• Assist in identifying trends and recurring issues that may require design or process improvements.

• Fluent in English and Mandarin Chinese (written and verbal).
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a
related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, engineering, energy storage systems, solar,
or power electronics.
• Technical knowledge equivalent to an advanced Tier 2 Engineer.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Experience working directly with engineering or R&D; teams.
Technical Expertise
• Advanced understanding of residential and commercial Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
• Strong knowledge of inverter, PCS, battery, BMS, Smart Home Panel, and communication system
operation.
• Ability to analyze system logs, error codes, commissioning data, and field reports to identify root
causes and recommend corrective actions.
• Strong understanding of system commissioning, grid-tied operation, backup operation, and energy
management strategies.
• Working knowledge of Time-of-Use (TOU), self-consumption, backup reserve settings, demand
management, and battery dispatch logic.
• Experience troubleshooting communication issues involving CAN, RS485, Ethernet, WinFi,
Bluetooth, and cloud-based monitoring platforms.
• Understanding of firmware, software, and application functionality, including validation of new
releases and feature enhancements.
• Ability to evaluate product performance and compare expected versus actual system behavior.
• Experience documenting root causes, corrective actions, and technical solutions for field
implementation.
